{{Top}}
'''Osmium''' was a metal that was worthless to primitive cultures (due to their low technology level) but valuable to spacefaring cultures.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

Approximately [[8000 BBY|eight thousand years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] traders discovered pure osmium ore on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. They traded the ore for flashy technological bagatelles with the primitive [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]].<ref name="Goroth" />
